# FADEC 与控制保护

_FADEC & Limit Protection_

发动机控制既要响应推力或功率需求，也要保护发动机的工作边界。公开 C-MAPSS40k 模型提供了整机动态模型与代表性控制器的学习案例。

_Engine control must respond to thrust or power demand while protecting operating limits. The public C-MAPSS40k model provides an example combining engine dynamics with a representative controller._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 区分指令、传感器反馈、控制律、执行机构和限制保护。

_Distinguish commands, sensor feedback, control laws, actuators and protective limits._

- 在同一工况下观察稳态误差、瞬态响应及约束，不只比较响应快慢。

_Compare steady error, transient response and constraints under the same operating conditions._

- 先阅读模型结构与适用范围；公开仿真模型不代表具体型号的控制实现。

_Check model structure and applicability first; a public simulation does not describe a particular production controller._
